name: Agendamento público - fluxo completo
description: Visitante acessa a página de agendamento, preenche dados, seleciona barbeiro, serviço, data/hora e confirma

planSteps.description: Verify the page displays a heading 'Preencha seus dados' or 'Seus dados' and a phone input field
Type '11987654321' in the phone input field (data-testid='input-phone')
Type 'Teste TestSprite' in the name input field (data-testid='input-name')
Click the 'Continuar' button (data-testid='next-step') to proceed past the data step
If a barber selection screen appears with the heading 'Quem vai te atender?', click on the barber named 'Tato' to select them before proceeding
Click the 'Continuar' button (data-testid='next-step') to proceed past the barber step to service selection
Verify service cards are visible on the page (look for buttons with data-testid='service-card')
Click on one of the available service cards (data-testid='service-card') to select it
Click the 'Continuar' button (data-testid='next-step') to proceed to date/time selection
Verify date picker buttons are visible on the page (look for buttons with data-testid='date-picker')
Click on one of the available date buttons (data-testid='date-picker') that is not disabled
Verify time slot buttons are displayed (look for buttons with data-testid='time-slot')
Click on one of the available time slot buttons (data-testid='time-slot' that is not disabled)
Click the 'Continuar' button (data-testid='next-step') to proceed to the review step
Verify the review page shows the client name and the selected service information
Click the 'Confirmar Agendamento' button (data-testid='confirm-booking') to finalize the booking
Verify a success or confirmation screen is displayed after booking completion
